svg.title: Pilot light, green incandescent
svg.desc: Pilot light, green incandescent, IEEE 315-1975 §11.1.1 lamp, §11.1.1B colour letter G and §11.1.4 incandescent filament. Not in the Schematex circuit exemplar; drawn to its rules with pins on the engine's anchors; one unit is one exemplar pixel. Pins: start (24,8), end (24,52).
